scope: Partial compression attempts retain each completed JPEG encoding
Completed quality PDFs and their reports are reused during target-size search
Quality and target-size compression in PDF tasks and recipes use referenced checkpoints
Native text edits retain page stream/new-font patches; original resource graphs stay in the final source document
Final generation and merge phases each hold one full source PDF at a time
New workId resumes completed stages; source documents and already published outputs retained
limits: Final PDF or ZIP container assembly remains atomic and is rerun after interruption
A single native encoding call is not preempted in its middle; completed image/page stages are retained
Recovery comparison is a new workId with persisted Room checkpoint records; physical device process-kill/performance is not claimed by these two checks
